Next, start from the first file in the current folder. What does the last line look like?" They want to see the last line of the first file in the current directory. So we need to list files in current directory, pick the first file, then display the last line of that file. We can use ls to list files, then cat or tail to get last line. But we need to know the file name. Let's list.
